outcome: Secondary cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise (IFC)
cohort: 87 pregnancies with an estimated fetal weight (EFW) < 10th centile above 36 gestational weeks
finding: Low umbilical vein blood flow corrected for abdominal circumference (UVBF/AC) was independently associated with an increased risk of secondary cesarean section for IFC among small-for-gestational-age fetuses.
mod_finding: Low umbilical vein blood flow was associated with increased risk of cesarean section for intrapartum fetal compromise in small-for-gestational-age fetuses.
